faq.meta_description: JetScope FAQ for launch readiness, source review, research workbench boundaries, scenario writes, and protected operations.
faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.question: Is this state a product failure, or is the capability intentionally not enabled?

scope.title: What can JetScope review today?
scope.why: The stated review scope shows which decisions the product can support without overstating its reach.
scope.body: JetScope combines jet-fuel prices, SAF breakeven pressure, EU reserve stress, source quality, saved scenario assumptions, and research signals into one review workflow.

readiness.title: Why can launch readiness be not ready?
readiness.why: Separating configuration gaps from product failures makes the correct recovery action clear.
readiness.body: Launch readiness reports the actual environment. Missing management configuration, disabled AI research, database issues, or degraded source coverage are disclosed as blockers or review items instead of being hidden.

sources.title: How should I read degraded or fallback sources?
sources.why: A degraded source changes where its figures are safe to use and therefore needs review before citation.
sources.body: Source review separates live, proxy, fallback, unavailable, and error states. A degraded source can still be useful, but it should be reviewed before procurement or reporting use.

research.title: Why might the research workbench be disabled?
research.why: Disabled research is not evidence that the market produced no new signal.
research.body: The Research workbench does not pretend that AI analysis is live when the pipeline is disabled or credentials are incomplete. It shows the boundary and the next review actions.

scenarios.title: Can I save scenarios or refresh market data here?
scenarios.why: Protected writes need explicit authorization before a read-only state can be treated as a malfunction.
scenarios.body: Scenario writes and refresh operations are protected. Without the configured management token, localized FAQ pages and review surfaces stay read-only and link back to the primary workspaces.

limitations: These answers describe the current deployment design intent and do not change with live data; use the Admin page for the environment’s actual readiness.
The FAQ does not replace the current states and limitations on the Sources, Research, or Scenarios pages.

prices.meta_description: English Germany jet-fuel market view for Brent, global jet fuel, EU jet proxy, carbon proxy, and 1d/7d/30d source-backed changes.
prices.title: Germany Jet-Fuel Price Monitor
prices.question: Has Germany's current jet-fuel price moved far enough to revisit the contract or hedging decision?
prices.decision_missing: The EU jet proxy has no current value.
prices.trend_why: A single print is one point. Only the 1d, 7d, and 30d windows show whether the move is large enough to revisit a contract or hedge.
prices.source_read_model: Source Review: Germany jet-fuel read model (Brent, global jet fuel, EU jet proxy, and carbon proxy)
prices.source_read_model_fallback: Germany jet-fuel read model unavailable; fallback estimates are in use ({error})
limitations: Jet-fuel prices are proxies and may differ from airport-specific or contract-settled prices in Germany.
The EU jet proxy can temporarily fall back to the global jet-fuel series when regional data is unavailable; a fallback is not a measurement.
The carbon proxy reflects policy-cost pressure and should be read with route and blend assumptions.
Decision support, not a trading feed. Compare procurement action with supplier quotes and internal contract terms.

research.meta_description: English JetScope research workbench for AI research pipeline status, signal counts, confidence, and evidence handoffs.
research.title: Research Workbench
research.question: Are today’s research signals strong enough to explain why the market is moving?

metrics.latest_none_hint: No persisted research signal is available for the current review window.
metrics.boundary_hint: Research explains possible causes; it never replaces market, reserve, scenario, or source review.

disabled.label: Disabled
disabled.detail: The research pipeline is disabled. This page does not claim that live AI analysis is running.

waiting.label: Waiting for signals
waiting.detail: The research API is enabled, but no persisted signal is available yet. The daily research job still needs to produce reviewable evidence.

not_found.label: Not deployed
not_found.detail: The research service is not deployed or cannot be found in this environment. An empty result is not a market finding.

error.label: Error
error.detail: Research API error: {message}. Do not cite research findings until it recovers.

ready.label: Running
ready.detail: The research API is enabled; this page displays persisted signals from the current review window.

status.title: Research pipeline status
status.why: Keep configuration boundaries, waiting, missing deployment, and failures distinct before citing a signal.

decision.title: Decision brief
decision.why: Research is explanatory evidence, not an autonomous recommendation for market or procurement decisions.

signals.title: Signal list
signals.why: The individual signals keep direction, source context, and confidence visible instead of hiding them in an aggregate.

actions.title: Evidence actions
actions.why: Every research signal must reconnect to the decision chain and a reviewable source.

research.summary_placeholder: No reviewed summary is available for this signal yet.
research.summary_en_cjk: English summary is not available for this signal yet.
research.summary_en_missing: No English summary is available for this signal yet.

actions.label: Review source evidence
actions.description: Check market provenance, proxy assumptions, fallback rows, and volatility before citing research signals.

actions.label: Open admin prerequisites
actions.description: Use the primary operations console to verify research configuration and protected refresh readiness.

footer.source_signals_ok: Research signal read model (direction, confidence, and publication time)
footer.source_signals_error: Research signal API is currently unavailable
footer.source_pipeline: Research pipeline enablement and deployment status
limitations: Research explains possible causes; it does not replace market, reserve, scenario, or source review.
Disabled, waiting, not deployed, or error states have no valid data-as-of. The timestamp comes only from the latest signal.
An empty result is not evidence that the market has not moved.
